// Get previous data from Extract Top 5 Workflows
const data = $json;

// Get best workflow
const workflow = data.workflows?.[0] || {};

const prompt = `
You are an Enterprise AI Workflow Monitoring & Analytics Expert.

Your task is to analyze an AI automation workflow and generate a professional analytics report.

Workflow Information:

Workflow Name:
${workflow.workflow_name || ""}

Workflow Category:
${workflow.workflow_category || ""}

Workflow Description:
${workflow.workflow_description || ""}

Technologies:
${workflow.technologies || ""}

Integrations:
${workflow.integrations || ""}

Use Cases:
${workflow.use_cases || ""}

Business Requirement:
${data.requirement || ""}

Search Information:

Search Status:
${data.search_status || ""}

Best Search Score:
${data.best_search_score || ""}

Total Matching Workflows:
${data.total_matches || 0}


Analyze this workflow based on:

1. Overall workflow performance
2. Automation capability
3. Complexity level
4. Scalability potential
5. Maintainability
6. Cost efficiency
7. Business impact
8. Strengths
9. Weaknesses
10. Improvement suggestions


Return ONLY valid JSON.

Do not use markdown.
Do not use code blocks.

Use this exact JSON structure:

{
  "workflow_name": "",
  "workflow_category": "",
  "performance_score": "",
  "automation_score": "",
  "complexity": "",
  "scalability": "",
  "maintainability": "",
  "cost_efficiency": "",
  "business_impact": "",
  "strengths": [],
  "weaknesses": [],
  "improvement_suggestions": ""
}
`;

return [
  {
    json: {

      requirement: data.requirement || "",

      workflow_name:
        workflow.workflow_name || "",

      workflow_category:
        workflow.workflow_category || "",

      workflow_description:
        workflow.workflow_description || "",

      search_status:
        data.search_status || "",

      best_search_score:
        data.best_search_score || 0,

      total_matches:
        data.total_matches || 0,

      prompt

    }
  }
];

return [
{
json:{
workflow_name: $json.workflow_name || "",

workflow_category: $json.workflow_category || "",

performance_score: $json.performance_score || "",

automation_score: $json.automation_score || "",

complexity: $json.complexity || "",

scalability: $json.scalability || "",

maintainability: $json.maintainability || "",

cost_efficiency: $json.cost_efficiency || "",

business_impact: $json.business_impact || "",

strengths: Array.isArray($json.strengths)
? $json.strengths.join(", ")
: $json.strengths || "",

weaknesses: Array.isArray($json.weaknesses)
? $json.weaknesses.join(", ")
: $json.weaknesses || "",

improvement_suggestions:
$json.improvement_suggestions || ""

}
}
];
